cold-no-s2-flag.note: PMU_CTL3 bit 4 clear: ordinary cold boot

resume-valid.note: S2 flag, not from S4, vector 0x00108000: resume

s2-but-from-s4.note: PMIC reg 0x14 bit 15 clear: "from s4", flag cleared

s2-vector-zero.note: S2 flag but no resume vector

resume-training-failure.note: mode-1 training error: RTC alarm +3 s, S2 flag re-set, power off

resume-alarm-check.note: vector bit 31 and alarm wake flag: DRAM restored, back to self-refresh, power off

resume-vector-bit31-no-alarm.note: vector bit 31 without alarm wake: bit cleared, jump

resume-stale-capacity.note: primary record says 512 MiB on 256 MiB hardware: programmed as stored, no check

resume-cs-zero.note: primary record cs = 0 (inconsistent): density divides by 0

adfu-request.note: pmu_status bit 1: ADFU entry before DRAM init

pmic-version-zero.note: PMIC version register 0: "pmu ver=0 not support" loop
